ios.desc:
Pins brings your Pinboard.in bookmarks to iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo.

• Browse your bookmarks, tags, and sites in one place.
• Create Smart Collections to filter bookmarks by title, description, tags, or URL.
• Revisit bookmarks you saved on this day in previous years.
• Save links from browsers and other apps with the share extension or Shortcuts.
• Rediscover saved links with a Home Screen widget.
• Find bookmarks through Spotlight.
• Use drag and drop, keyboard shortcuts, and Handoff.
• Choose separate accent colours for light and dark appearances.

Built for iOS 27 and later, with Liquid Glass controls and layouts that adapt to iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo displays.

A Pinboard.in account is required. Additional features are available through in-app purchases.
